rows_qa.question: What body of water was dry land during the last ice age, besides the Irish Channel and the sea near the former Atlantic Hotel?
rows_qa.answer: The English Channel was dry land during the last ice age [1]. During the last glacial period, sea level was approximately 120 meters lower than today, which exposed the English Channel, the Irish Channel, and most of the North Sea as land [1].
